newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch call money falls on strong liquidity influx.
newsitem.headline: Dutch call money falls on strong liquidity influx.

text.p: Dutch call money rates nosedived again on Wednesday, surprising the market as Tuesday's allocation under a seven-day advances pact seemed adequate but not overdone.
"There is more than sufficient liquidity in the market," said one dealer, adding call money rates could fall further after hitting 2.25 percent bid around midday from around 2.62 percent on Tuesday.
Other rates were unchanged with three-month deposits trading at 2.78 percent bid and six-month deposits were bid at 2.80 percent.
The guilder was slightly weaker against the mark at 112.18 per 100 marks from 112.16 on Tuesday.
